investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Verdlane Shop (online retail); Platform: AWS ca-central-1 (zones ca-central-1a/ca-central-1b/ca-central-1d); network range 10.212.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster verdla-prod-cacent (EKS); Database: mysql instance inventory-db-01 for inventory-svc; Deployments: Helm releases rolled out by a CI release bot after human approval; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
